title: teleport
description: Teleports entities  to specific locations. Can also be written as `/tp`.

destination.title: destination
destination.description: The `vector` [x y z] position to teleport entities to.

checkforblocks.title: checkForBlocks
checkforblocks.description: A `Boolean` value to prevent teleporting the player if the location they would end up in is occupied by blocks if `true`. Default: `false`.

yrot.title: yRot
yrot.description: The `float` degrees `y` to rotate a player when teleporting.

xrot.title: xRot
xrot.description: The `float` degrees `x` to rotate a player when teleporting.

lookatposition.title: lookAtPosition
lookatposition.description: A `vector` [x y z] of where teleported entities should face.

lookatentity.title: lookAtEntity
lookatentity.description: A `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify which `entity` teleported entities should face.

victim.title: victim
victim.description: A `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify which player is teleported.
